content_of_post_to_comment:
Heyyy everyone!! My brain keeps telling me to go for it “one last time” everyday..., and it’s getting really tiring. I’ve been stuck in this cycle for a long time and I don’t really know how to get out of it.

I’ll manage to control myself for 2–3 days and genuinely feel like I’m doing better.

Then I start feeling sad, lonely, or stressed, and I end up going back to the same thing again.

It can be smartphone addiction or other short-term pleasures that I use when I’m trying to escape how I feel.

After relapsing, I feel guilty and disappointed in myself, so I try to “start again” and convince myself that this time will be different.

Then the same thing happens again after a few days.

The loneliness part is probably one of the biggest problems for me. I don’t have many friends or much of a social life outside, so when I’m alone for too long, it gets really difficult. Even if I’m doing well and staying disciplined, I can suddenly feel very empty and start looking for something that gives me quick pleasure or distraction.

I’ve been trying to fix this by just forcing myself to quit and go straight into being disciplined for almost 3 years now. But honestly, it doesn’t seem to work for me. I can push myself for some time, but eventually the stress, boredom, loneliness, or sadness catch up and I end up relapsing as always. :(((

What I’m trying to understand is:

How do you actually deal with the urges when they keep coming back every day?

How do you handle loneliness when you don’t have many people around you?

How do you build accountability without becoming obsessed with tracking every failure?

How do you deal with a relapse without completely destroying your self-esteem?

And how do you make progress when simply relying on discipline and motivation clearly hasn’t worked for you?

I’m not really looking for the usual “just have more discipline” advice because I’ve genuinely been trying that for years. I’m looking for specific, practical things that have actually helped people break this kind of cycle while still being able to have a normal life and not hate themselves every time they slip up.

I feel like I need a different approach rather than just trying to fight myself harder every day.
